set -eu
Rscript -e 'args <- commandArgs(TRUE); d <- read.delim(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="\t", quote="", check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("", "NA")); efficacy <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]])); bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[["BMI"]])); keep <- !is.na(efficacy) & efficacy != "" & !is.na(bmi); efficacy <- efficacy[keep]; bmi <- bmi[keep]; allowed <- efficacy %in% c("PR", "SD", "PD"); if (!all(allowed)) stop(paste("Unexpected efficacy labels:", paste(sort(unique(efficacy[!allowed])), collapse=","))); y <- as.integer(efficacy == "PR"); if (length(unique(y)) != 2L) stop("Binary response does not contain both PR and non-PR observations"); dat <- data.frame(y=y, BMI=bmi); fit <- glm(y ~ BMI, family=binomial(link="logit"), data=dat); ll <- as.numeric(logLik(fit)); kval <- attr(logLik(fit), "df"); out <- data.frame(metric=c("method","formula","event","non_event","n_complete","n_pr","n_non_pr","k","logLik","AIC","intercept","bmi_coefficient"), value=c("stats::glm binomial logit","PR_indicator ~ BMI","PR","SD_or_PD",nrow(dat),sum(y == 1L),sum(y == 0L),kval,format(ll,digits=17,scientific=FALSE),format(AIC(fit),digits=17,scientific=FALSE),format(unname(coef(fit)[1]),digits=17,scientific=FALSE),format(unname(coef(fit)[2]),digits=17,scientific=FALSE)), stringsAsFactors=FALSE); write.table(out, file="result.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)' "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/80290374/inputs/dataset_c9b1c264-9513-4750-951d-a7f632325fc4.dat"
